verdict.rationale: Postman's first-party docs say its API client can create and send HTTP, GraphQL, and gRPC requests, and that a lightweight client supports multi-protocol requests without sign-in. WebSocket and SSE are never named, so only half of the story's protocols are evidenced. Missing for 10: documented WebSocket support, documented SSE support, independent or hands-on corroboration of non-REST protocol requests.
